name: upli_receive_fifo
description: Synchronous SRAM receive FIFO controller; see docs/receive_storage_plan.md for actual backend and complete credit integration scope.

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: User authorized complete UALink RTL and reuse of repository FIFO/SRAM models using local Verilator/Yosys/OpenSTA. This internal synchronous FIFO control contract does not add native UPLI ready or protocol fields.

behavior: Depth1..65535; positive byte-multiple width; total capacity includes unread SRAM, one read-pending word and up to two cached words.
SRAM read result becomes available after request edge and is captured at next edge. Read input must meet this contract; backend is separately bound.
Two reserved cache slots support steady one-word-per-cycle read/write, with no empty write bypass and no full same-edge capacity borrowing.
Reset clears all controller/cache state; SRAM contents need not reset. New writes and valid read scheduling prevent stale data visibility.
constraints: All RTL-MD MUST rules apply; native UPLI project snake_case and short bilingual headers retained.
Authored Verilog-2001 source has Chinese same-line semantic comments and one register per sequential always.
External KD28 model/storage mapping is read-only and is not restyled or bundled; explicit caller root and hash identity required.
notes: Integer schema widths denote depth5/width32 default; derived count/address width is depth.bit_length() and inconsistent override rejected.
SRAM controls are combinational enables/address to the same-clock registered memory, not asynchronous crossings.
No complete UPLI receive channel, credit handoff, protocol package, or analog macro signoff claimed by this controller.
